channel.title: Valerie Andy's Blog
channel.description: Hi I'm Valerie Andy, and this is my blog. Home to my audio visualizer series exploring sonic identity through creative code, released every Wednesday. As a computational designer, I dive deep into the intersection of sound, code, and visual expression.

item.title: StarViz: Building an Audio-Reactive GLSL Visualizer
item.description: Reverse-engineering the dreamy, pulsing visualizer from Peggy Gou's website. I break down how I built this from the ground up by layering effects in a single fragment shader in GLSL, creating a radial starburst pattern that pulses and gradient-cycles in sync with music.
item.dc:creator: Valerie Andy

item.title: Painting with Math: A Gentle Study of Raymarching
item.description: A compilation of my Raymarching and Signed Distance Field learnings and work. In it, I teach you how to leverage those techniques along with lighting models, smoothmin, soft shadows, and some math to create beautiful 3D raymarched scenes ranging from abstract shapes to infinite realistic-looking landscapes.
